Full summary: 2.7.0 SHIPPED: npm publish succeeded (twining-mcp@2.7.0 live), plugin 1.25.0, tag v2.7.0. All five field defects fixed, two adversarial review rounds (18 confirmed findings) closed, live smoke ALL PASS. Field memo at docs/field-responses/2026-08-06-handoff-response.md ready to send
Decisions: Chose to ship with the plugin-token-budget CI job red rather than trim plugin skills or re-baseline the cap — verified the identical 5119-byte overrun exists at v2.6.0, so it is a pre-existing failure unrelated to this release (this release touched no skills/agents files the gate counts); trimming skill content or moving a deliberate guardrail is a scope decision for the owner, not a release-gate patch
Findings: warning: plugin-token-budget CI job has been failing since at least v2.6.0 — plugin/skills+agents at 41735 bytes vs 36616 cap (+36% vs +20% allowed); Publish is not gated on it, but main CI shows red on every push until skills are trimmed or the cap is re-baselined; need: send docs/field-responses/2026-08-06-handoff-response.md to the agentic-platform-design field repo and have them upgrade to 2.7.0 + delete their interim-guidance section; git stash without -u stashes nothing when only untracked files differ — a later stash pop then applies someone ELSE's stash entry; check stash list before pop in this repo (two long-lived stashes exist)
